title: Tamsin and the Ghost
author: Oscar Yarrow
blurb: Emrys Sterling, a whistle-blower living under four names, keeps a go-bag packed and a lie polished. Then a dead handler sends a meeting invitation for tomorrow — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must get the truth past three governments and one assassin before the extraction flight leaves at dawn.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
